summary.text: Mari-Lynn Poskin is a Democratic state representative who has represented District 20 since January 2021 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A business owner, she is the ranking minority member of the Veterans and Military Committee.

paragraphs.text: Mari-Lynn Poskin was born in Merced, California, and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Nebraska at Lincoln in 1988.
Her career experience includes working as a grant writer with the Northern Illinois Council on Alcoholism and Substance Abuse and owning KC College Connect.
She has served with Stand Up Blue Valley and Game On for Kansas Schools.
Poskin took office in the Kansas House on January 11, 2021, succeeding Jan Kessinger.

For 2025 and 2026 she is assigned to the Commerce, Labor and Economic Development, Financial Institutions and Pensions, K-12 Education Budget, and Veterans and Military committees, and is ranking minority member of Veterans and Military.
